features.text: Patient's acne has been improving, especially on the face.
No new acne lesions or changes in the distribution of acne since starting treatment.
Patient is using benzoyl peroxide wash, antibiotic, and retinoin cream as prescribed.
No irritation or dryness from the prescribed acne treatments.
Acne is primarily on the face, with no significant issues on the back or chest.
Patient is satisfied with the current skincare routine and its effectiveness.
